decision_gate.pass: All frozen captures exist with source-state labels; pixel-only independent reconstruction agrees exactly with candidate kernels and all Bayes risks; semantic positive control distinguishes all states; mutation negative control is state-uninformative; every defined corruption is rejected.
decision_gate.fail: Any false/missing capture, label mismatch, invalid kernel, incorrect relation/risk, or undetected defined mutation.
decision_gate.hold: Raw screenshot/a11y evidence cannot be independently interpreted, capture evidence is incomplete, or a true independent audit cannot be completed.
decision_gate.stop: Any source, branch, fixture, executable, schedule, or runtime mismatch before a formal invocation. No retry or replacement allocation.

scope: Authored static DOM fixture rendered by one local Playwright Chromium build only; not Agent Interface, real app, model, effect, safety, latency, or product evidence.
